title: 第19章 铩羽第20章 药成

第一九章 铩羽
“武童大哥，你发什么呆？”见武童傻愣愣的，奚落聂空正起劲的二林和三木忍不住叫道。
“这……这……”武童一个激灵惊醒过来，抓着小玉瓶的手都有点颤抖，难以置信地看着聂空，他怎么可能弄来真的回春露？
“这什么这？拿来！”
见状，聂风行心底不由得升起了一丝不妙的预感，低声喝道。武童不敢怠慢，赶紧将瓶子送上。
馨香飘入鼻端，瓶内装着的是乳汁般的白色**，正是“回春露”的模样。
根本无需尝试，只凭从瓶口冒出来的那股浓郁的灵力，聂风行便知道这“回春露”是真的，而且质量比他送给花眉的那瓶有过之而无不及，像这瓶回春露若是拿出去卖，起码能值一万五金币。
难不成今天又要无功而返？聂风行面色发青，更加猛烈的怒火在胸中燃烧，捏着玉瓶的手指指关节微微发白。
二郎腿一翘，聂空好整以暇地坐在了床沿处，笑吟吟的提醒道：“轻点，捏碎了瓶子我可不负责。”
“好，很好！”
聂风行牙齿缝里挤出几个字，狠狠地盯了聂空一眼，目光移到了武童等人身上，神色极其不善。
原本看到聂空渐渐露出卑躬屈膝的模样，聂风行心里还颇为享受，可这瓶回春露一出来，他才突然发现在聂空面前，自己几个人就像是一只只上窜下跳的猴子、自鸣得意地展现着红屁股。
武童三人再无先前的半分嚣张，在聂风行那愤怒得似要杀人的目光注视下，个个噤若寒蝉，连大气都不敢喘一口，准备承受三少爷的暴风骤雨。要知道在来之前，他们还信誓旦旦的保证，聂空绝对拿不出一万金币去购买回春露，现在三少爷吃瘪，肯定得把火气发泄在他们头上。
“聂空，我倒是小看你了。”出乎意料，聂风行的眼神很快回到了聂空身上，展颜微笑了起来。
“过奖。”
聂空神色平静。
他很清楚，在原先的聂风行眼中，自己就跟一条躺在砧板上待宰的鱼差不多，可如今聂风行一刀斩下来，自己这条鱼不但没有皮开肉绽，反倒溅了他满脸带着鱼腥味的水珠，他怎会善罢甘休？
果然，聂风行随即变脸，声音沉冷得似从九幽地狱吹出来的一缕阴风：“可惜，你就算还了‘回春露’也没用，我这里还有一张花眉借‘回春露’时所写的借据，白纸黑字，谁能抵赖？”
聂风行展开一张写有歪歪扭扭字迹的白纸，哗啦啦地冲聂空挥了挥，而后向武童示意了一下：“念给他听听。”
真是峰回路转！

“是！”
武童喜出望外，连忙从聂风行手中接过纸张，大声念道：“今向聂风行借‘回春露’一瓶，若三天内未能归还，则以本人抵债，为奴为婢，悉随聂风行之意！花眉！天灵历九九九七年九月二十三日。”
聂风行眯眼道：“武童，今天是什么日子？”
武童瞥了聂空一眼，笑嘻嘻的躬身道：“回三少爷，今天已经是二十八了，超过期限两天。”
“噗。”
看两人一唱一和，聂空忍俊不禁，咳嗽了几声，道，“三少爷，你确定这是我嫂嫂亲笔写的借据？”
聂风行拿过借据在聂空面前抖了抖，冷笑道：“上面的笔迹还能有假？就算笔迹有假，难道手印还能造假不成？”
武童附和道：“有借据在这，花眉从今往后就是三少爷的了，即便是闹到长老会，也改变不了什么。”
聂空一点都不着急，微笑道：“我再问一遍，这真是我嫂嫂亲手写的？”说到“亲手”二字，聂空加重了语调。
“当然。”
聂风行一副胜券在握的模样。
聂空用一种同情的目光看着聂风行，调侃的笑道：“三少爷，忘记告诉你了，我嫂嫂嫁进我家前曾经失忆过，以前的很多事情都忘记了，甚至连怎么写字也忘光了，现在她会写的只有‘花眉’两字。”
“什么？”
聂风行神色骤变。武童、二林和三木也是嗔目结舌，最有利的证据居然就这么变成了一张废纸。
武童强辩道：“你说她不会写字就不会写字，谁信呀？”
聂空很好心的道：“这一点给我哥哥和嫂嫂主婚的九长老也知道，三少爷或许可以去找他老人家求证求证。”
九长老？
听到这三字，还待反唇相讥的武童闭起了嘴巴。
聂风行脸色一阵青一阵红，蹭地站了起来，阴声道：“聂空，你有种，本少爷二十多年还是第一次吃这么大亏。”
聂空也不再客气，冷笑道：“我当然有种，不像某些人，骗我嫂嫂在白纸上签下姓名，按下手印，然后连情况都不摸清楚，就根据那两个字的笔迹伪造出所谓的借据，脑袋里面装的都是狗屎么？”

“你！”
聂风行哪被人这么辱骂过，气得眼前直发黑，面庞直接胀成了猴屁股。
武童见状暗暗窃喜，连忙发挥出狗腿子的特色，凶神恶煞地怒叱道：“聂空，你敢骂三少爷？”
二林和三木开始握拳捋袖，跃跃欲试。
“怎么，想动手了？”
聂空嗤笑道，房间里的气氛变得紧张起来，一触即发。
“哈哈，这里好热闹。”
一阵爽朗的大笑声传来，门口走进来一个满面髭须的中年壮汉，正是灵药堂门口的守卫聂青锋。
聂空有些诧异，起身拱手道：“见过青锋族叔。”武童三人却是吓了一跳，一溜烟闪到了聂风行身后。
聂风行本来还想拼着事后受一顿训斥，让武童等人借机生事，狠狠把聂空揍一顿。可聂青锋的突然出现，却让他再没有了达成目的的希望，心头越发憋闷，这一次，真的是栽到家了。
“走！”
聂风行深吸口气，黑着脸大步向房外迈去，临走时冷冷地斜乜了聂空一下，眼神中隐隐露着杀机。
武童、二林、三木灰溜溜跟上。
庭院门口，看着怒气冲冲的聂风行和屁颠屁颠地武童等人消失在巷道拐角处，刚刚买菜回来的花眉呆了片刻，忽地面露惊慌焦灼之色，玉手提着裙摆，三步并作两步向聂空的卧室跑去。

Chapter 19: Feather
"Brother Wutong, what are you doing?" Erlin and Sanmu couldn't help shouting when they saw Wutong being dumbfounded and taunting Nie Kong.
"This... this..." Wu Tong woke up with a startle. His hand holding the small jade bottle was trembling a little. He looked at Nie Kong in disbelief. How could he get the real rejuvenation dew?
"What is this? Bring it!"
Seeing this, Nie Fengxing could not help but feel a bad premonition in his heart, and shouted in a low voice. Wu Tong did not dare to neglect and quickly handed over the bottle.
The fragrant fragrance floats into the nose, and the bottle contains milk-like white liquid, which is exactly what "Rejuvenation Dew" looks like.
Without even trying, Nie Fengxing knew that the "Rejuvenating Dew" was real based on the strong spiritual power emerging from the mouth of the bottle, and its quality was even better than the bottle he gave to Huamei. If this bottle of Rejuvenating Dew was sold, it would be worth at least fifteen thousand gold coins.
Is it possible that today we will return without success again? Nie Fengxing's face turned blue, more intense anger burned in his chest, and the knuckles of the fingers holding the jade bottle turned slightly white.
Erlang's legs crossed, and Nie Kong sat on the edge of the bed leisurely, reminding him with a smile: "Be gentle, I won't be responsible for crushing the bottle."
"Okay, good!"
Nie Fengxing squeezed out a few words between his teeth, stared at Nie Kong fiercely, and moved his eyes to Wu Tong and others with extremely unkind expressions.
Initially, Nie Fengxing was quite enjoying seeing Nie Kong's groveling appearance, but as soon as the bottle of rejuvenation came out, he suddenly realized that in front of Nie Kong, he and the others were like monkeys jumping up and down, showing off their red butts smugly.
Wu Tong and the other three no longer had the slightest arrogance as before. Under Nie Fengxing's eyes that were so angry that he wanted to kill, they all remained silent, not even daring to take a breath, preparing to withstand the storm of the third young master. You must know that before they came, they had sworn that Nie Kong would never be able to spend 10,000 gold coins to buy the rejuvenating dew. Now that the third young master is frustrated, he will definitely vent his anger on them.
"Nie Kong, I underestimated you." Unexpectedly, Nie Fengxing's eyes quickly returned to Nie Kong, and he smiled.
"Excellent."
Nie Kong looked calm.
He knew very well that in the eyes of the original Nie Fengxing, he was just like a fish lying on the chopping board to be slaughtered. But now, Nie Fengxing chopped it off with one knife. Not only did his fish not have its skin torn open, but instead splashed water droplets with a fishy smell all over his face. How could he give up?
Sure enough, Nie Fengxing's face changed immediately, and his voice was as cold as a wisp of wind blowing from the Nine Nether Hell: "Unfortunately, it is useless even if you return the 'Rejuvenating Dew'. I also have an IOU written by Huamei when I borrowed the 'Rejuvenating Dew'. It is written in black and white. Who can deny it?"
Nie Fengxing unfolded a piece of white paper with crooked handwriting, waved at Nie Kong, and then gestured to Wu Tong: "Read it to him."
What a twist!
"Yes!"
Wu Tong was overjoyed and quickly took the paper from Nie Fengxing and read loudly: "I will borrow a bottle of 'Rejuvenation Dew' from Nie Fengxing. If I cannot return it within three days, I will pay off the debt myself and become a slave. I will do whatever Nie Fengxing wants! Huamei! It is September 23rd in the Tianling Calendar, 9997."
Nie Fengxing narrowed his eyes and said, "Wu Tong, what day is today?"
Wu Tong glanced at Nie Kong, bowed with a smile and said: "Back to Third Young Master, today is already twenty-eight, and it is two days past the deadline."
"Pfft."
Seeing the two singing in harmony, Nie Kong couldn't help laughing, coughed a few times, and said, "Third Young Master, are you sure this is an IOU written by my sister-in-law?"
Nie Fengxing took the IOU, shook it in front of Nie Kong, and sneered: "Can the handwriting on it be fake? Even if the handwriting is fake, can the fingerprints be fake?"
Wu Tong echoed: "With the IOU here, Huamei will be the third young master's from now on, even if it isEven going to the Presbyterian Church won't change anything. "
Nie Kong was not anxious at all and said with a smile: "I ask again, is this really written by my sister-in-law? "When it came to the word "with my own hands," Nie Kong emphasized his tone.
"Of course. "
Nie Fengxing looked like he was sure of victory.
Nie Kong looked at Nie Fengxing with a sympathetic look, and said with a teasing smile: "Third Young Master, I forgot to tell you, my sister-in-law had amnesia before she married into my family. She has forgotten many things in the past, and even how to write. Now the only word she can write is '花美'." "
"What? "
Nie Fengxing's expression suddenly changed. Wu Tong, Er Lin and Miki were also dumbfounded. The most favorable evidence turned into a piece of waste paper.
Wu Tong argued forcefully: "You said she can't write because she can't write. Who would believe it? "
Nie Kong said kindly: "The Ninth Elder who presided over the marriage of my brother and sister-in-law also knows this, and the Third Young Master may be able to go to him for verification. "
Ninth Elder?
After hearing these three words, Wu Tong, who was still waiting for a retort, closed his mouth.
Nie Fengxing's face turned green and red, he stood up and said in a dark voice: "Nie Kong, you have the guts, this is the first time for this young master to suffer such a big loss in more than 20 years. "
Nie Kong stopped being polite and sneered: "Of course I have the guts, unlike some people who tricked my sister-in-law into signing her name on a piece of white paper, pressing her fingerprints, and then forged a so-called IOU based on the handwriting of those two words without even knowing the situation clearly. Is that all bullshit in my head? "
"you! "
Nie Fengxing had never been insulted like this before. He was so angry that his eyes turned black and his face swelled into a monkey's butt.
When Wu Tong saw this, he secretly rejoiced, and quickly displayed his characteristics of being a dog-legger, angrily scolding: "Nie Kong, you dare to scold the third young master? "
Erlin and Sanmu started to clench their fists and roll up their sleeves, eager to give it a try.
"What, you want to take action? "
Nie Kong sneered, and the atmosphere in the room became tense and about to explode.
“Haha, it’s so lively here. "
A burst of hearty laughter came, and a middle-aged man with a mustache walked in the door. It was Nie Qingfeng, the guard at the entrance of the Spiritual Medicine Hall.
Nie Kong was a little surprised, stood up and cupped his hands and said: "I have met Uncle Qingfeng Clan. "Wu Tong and the other three were startled, and quickly darted behind Nie Fengxing.
Nie Fengxing originally wanted to get a scolding afterwards and let Wu Tong and others take the opportunity to cause trouble and beat Nie Kong severely. But Nie Qingfeng's sudden appearance gave him no hope of achieving his goal, and he became more and more depressed. This time, he was really in trouble.
"Go! "
Nie Fengxing took a deep breath and strode out of the room with a dark face. Before leaving, he gave Nie Kong a cold tilt, with a hint of murderous intent in his eyes.
Wu Tong, Er Lin, and Miki followed in despair.
At the entrance of the courtyard, watching the angry Nie Fengxing, Pingpiandi Wutong and others disappearing around the corner of the alley, Huamei, who had just returned from shopping for groceries, was stunned for a moment, and suddenly looked panicked and anxious. She held her skirt in her hand and ran towards Nie Kong's bedroom in three steps.
